name: 慈音
negative_extra_cn: 凌厉、阴郁、华丽张扬、血腥

stand.desc_cn: 微躬约8°，双肩内收，双手拢于袖中于腹前捧玉葫芦，眉眼含笑，温润亲和
stand.desc_en: slightly bowed about 8 degrees, shoulders drawn in, hands gathered in sleeves holding the jade gourd at the front, warm smiling eyes, gentle and kindly

halfbody.desc_cn: 半身像，微微躬身，双手交于身前捧玉葫芦，暖光萦绕，神态安宁慈和
halfbody.desc_en: half-body, slight bow, hands clasped in front holding the jade gourd, warm light lingering, serene and compassionate expression
